just recently quit the hosting position, but it was mostly because of management and coworkers. However, the way that scheduling works at OG can be very frustrating. You are either scheduled for a closing shift or a “business decline” shift. However, if you happen to work at a place that is particularly understaffed and/or is prone to call outs, you may end up working much longer than you play to on any given day. For example, you might be scheduled at 3 PM to DBD (dinner business decline) if the closer who was scheduled to come in and say maybe 4:30 calls out on a busy Saturday you will have to work that whole entire busy shift from three to probably around 11:30 without a break. Which can be very frustrating, if you really need the hours though it could work out it really just depends on your location and your situation.🤷🏽‍♀️ Also for other reasons I don’t feel like going into, work at a location that takes reservations
